description: NBA preseason resolved game markets with one-minute Kalshi quote history and ESPN/NBA play-by-play moment evidence. Public read-only endpoints. Probabilities are midpoint of Kalshi yes bid/ask close quotes, expressed on 0..1 scale.
historyMethod: GET /series/{series_ticker}/markets/{ticker}/candlesticks?start_ts={unix}&end_ts={unix}&period_interval=1; one-minute periods. `points[].t` is end_period_ts in ISO UTC; `p` is (yes_bid.close_dollars + yes_ask.close_dollars)/2.
limitations: Kalshi API candles record quote bid/ask close values, not trade price OHLC; midpoint is a derived probability proxy.
Some minutes have zero volume and quote values repeat, so points may be stale.
ESPN wallclock timestamps are provider play-by-play timestamps. They are not independently verified broadcast times; no API latency adjustment was applied.
These are preseason NBA games, so roster and competitive context differ from regular season.

market.title: Milwaukee Bucks vs Oklahoma City Thunder

events.momentText: With Milwaukee leading 126-124, Ousmane Dieng made both free throws with 4.0 seconds remaining, extending the lead to 128-124; Oklahoma City scored a tip-in at 0.5 seconds, but Milwaukee won 128-126.

momentPlay.text: Ousmane Dieng makes free throw 2 of 2

events.historyResolution: 1 minute; yes bid/ask close quotes; `points` use midpoint (quote dollars = probability).
limitations: No post-resolution candles are returned after the market settles, so the requested window may end early.
One-minute values are midpoints of displayed yes bid and ask close quotes, not last-trade prices; zero-volume intervals can repeat stale quotes.
Moment timestamps use ESPN play-by-play wallclock fields; no broadcast latency correction was applied.
